name: Oranguru

attacks.name: Primate’s Trap
attacks.text: During your opponent’s next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 {Colorless} more, and its Retreat Cost is 1 {Colorless} more.

flavor:
People used to mistake Oranguru for a human
when they saw it issue command after command
to the other Pokémon of the forest.
